calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Auctane
calls.summary: The team is creating a comprehensive dashboard designed to visualize and filter experiment results, allowing flexibility in data analysis from single to multiple experiments. Manual entry of contextual tags enables users to categorize experiments by themes, facilitating the identification of patterns and insights. Areas of interest include educator content and character usage, indicating a need for improved data collection in these aspects. The dashboard also supports various experiment running modes, accommodating both small-scale and large-scale testing efforts, thus enabling teams to track concurrent experiments and maintain a complete view of their impact.
calls.keywords: Dashboard, Experiment Results, Filtering, Product Page, Data Categorization, Performance Analysis
calls.action_items:
**Unassigned**
Review and refine the filtering capabilities of the dashboard for diverse experiment stages to enhance user analysis (04:17)
Develop a method to manually enter or tag data related to specific pages (like product pages) to better track experiment commonalities (04:17)

calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for Auctane
calls.summary: GrowthBook account manager Jake Heier demoed the platform to Auctane CRO manager Erin Rizal, who is seeking a more cost-effective AB testing alternative to Optimizely. Key pain points included Optimizely’s high cost for unused features, the need for a visual editor and code snippet support, and integration with BigQuery, Google Analytics, and HubSpot. Next steps: Jake will share a video of the visual editor, provide a ballpark pricing estimate ($65–85k annually), and potentially set up a free trial.
